meaning.hi: बंधन और मोक्ष कहे जाने लगते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: there is no covering upon brahman anywhere
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म पर कहीं कोई ढक्कन नहीं

meaning.en: uncovered, because nothing else exists to cover it
meaning.hi: अनढँका, क्योंकि कोई और चीज़ है ही नहीं

meaning.en: the notion that a thing exists
meaning.hi: यह विचार कि कोई चीज़ है

meaning.en: and the notion that it does not exist
meaning.hi: और यह कि वह नहीं है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: both of these belong to the intellect alone
meaning.hi: ये दोनों बुद्धि के ही गुण हैं

meaning.en: not of the thing that lasts forever
meaning.hi: उस नित्य वस्तु के नहीं

meaning.en: so these two, put together by maya
meaning.hi: इसलिए ये दोनों, माया द्वारा रचे

meaning.en: bondage and liberation, are not in the self
meaning.hi: बंधन और मोक्ष, आत्मा में नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: in what has no parts, no action, at peace
meaning.hi: अखंड में, अक्रिय में, शांत में

meaning.en: with no fault, no stain
meaning.hi: निरवद्य में, निरंजन में

meaning.en: in the highest truth, which has no second
meaning.hi: अद्वितीय परम तत्त्व में

meaning.en: where could an imagined thing come from, any more than in the sky?
meaning.hi: आकाश की तरह, कल्पना कहाँ से आएगी?

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: nothing held back, nothing coming into being
meaning.hi: न कोई रोक, न कोई उत्पत्ति

meaning.en: no one tied down, no one working to get free
meaning.hi: न कोई बँधा, न कोई साधक

meaning.en: no one wanting to be free, and no one actually free
meaning.hi: न कोई मुमुक्षु, न कोई मुक्त

meaning.en: that is how it stands, put in its highest form
meaning.hi: यही है परमार्थता
